Fling strength (climbing)
Gun hand: trigger fires, A takes the gun out or puts it away, B marks where you aim, stick snaps 30°. Off hand: stick walks (click it to sprint), trigger shows the map, hold Y for the menu, grip holds the gun's front grip. Raise the gun to your eye with both hands to scope; crouch for real. With empty hands: reach into anything (your hand glows blue) and squeeze grip to climb; both grips at your face for binoculars; spread your arms to glide the way they point.
